description: Incident communications products often pair public-page pricing with notification and access-scope language, so teams can understand who sees what and how alerts are delivered.
Publishing tools work best when the product distinguishes a page, a site, and any custom-domain add-on so users do not assume every share action creates a public website.
Video workspace products often present a broad suite landing page first and then branch into specialized public pathways such as home or government to clarify which audience should continue.
Commerce platforms usually pair simple public pricing with enterprise or channel-specific pages so merchants can distinguish self-serve entry from larger-contract terms.
